rationale: Archive US Water Systems as an unsupported repository umbrella and retain the separately published Bayonne and Middletown concession records. Direct sources identify two distinct concession investments and no legal or operating US Water Systems platform. Argo acquired the KKR and SUEZ interests in the underlying concessions in 2017, and current project, operator and municipal records show both remain active. Apollo's proposed acquisition of the Argo manager did not close and was terminated in January 2026, so Apollo creates no owner period, vehicle label or pending transaction. A one-to-many redirect would be false; archive the umbrella without a redirect while preserving its audit history.
